description: This file defines the ArrayMapper class within the SuiteCRM Utility namespace. The class provides functionality to map arrays or objects according to specified mappings, regex mappings, and blacklists. It includes methods for loading configuration from YAML files, setting properties fluently, and performing recursive mapping operations. The class is designed to facilitate customizable array transformations in the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: ArrayMapper
classes.description: Handles array/object mapping based on user-defined configurations such as mappings, regex mappings, and blacklists. Supports flexible recursion, string decoding, and customizable behavior for hiding empty values.

methods.name: getMappings
methods.description: Returns the current mappings array.

methods.name: setMappings
methods.description: Sets the mappings array and returns self for fluent interface.

methods.name: getMappable
methods.description: Retrieves the array or object to be mapped.

methods.name: setMappable
methods.description: Sets the data (array or object) to be mapped and resets the cleanArray.

methods.name: getRegexMappings
methods.description: Returns the regex mappings array.

methods.name: setRegexMappings
methods.description: Sets the regex mappings array.

methods.name: getBlacklist
methods.description: Returns the blacklist array.

methods.name: setBlacklist
methods.description: Sets the blacklist array.

methods.name: isHideEmptyValues
methods.description: Indicates whether empty values should be hidden during mapping.

methods.name: setHideEmptyValues
methods.description: Sets the flag to hide empty values.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate ArrayMapper with fluent syntax.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Performs the mapping operation on the set mappable data, returning the mapped array.

methods.name: loadYaml
methods.description: Loads configuration settings (mappings, regex mappings, blacklist) from a specified YAML file.

methods.name: mapArray
methods.description: Recursively maps an array based on the defined mappings.

methods.name: mapObject
methods.description: Recursively maps an object based on the defined mappings.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main control loop executing the mapping logic for each key-value pair.

methods.name: handleStructure
methods.description: Handles nested arrays or objects during mapping.

methods.name: handleMap
methods.description: Applies the user-defined mappings to the current key-value pair.

methods.name: handleRegex
methods.description: Applies regex-based mappings if the pattern matches the current path.

methods.name: handleDefault
methods.description: Default handler to assign value to the current path if no other rule matches.

methods.name: updatePath
methods.description: Updates the current property path during recursive mapping.

methods.name: fixStringValue
methods.description: Decodes HTML entities in string values.

methods.name: shouldSkipEmpty
methods.description: Determines if empty or null values should be skipped based on settings.

methods.name: putInPath
methods.description: Assigns a value at a specified path in the result array.

methods.name: appendInPath
methods.description: Appends a value to an array at a specified path.

methods.name: getArrayAtPath
methods.description: Retrieves a reference to the nested array at the specified path, creating nested structure if necessary.

methods.name: isBlackListed
methods.description: Checks if a given path is in the blacklist.

methods.name: handleValue
methods.description: Stores the value at the mapped path, supporting append operations with '+' prefix.
